purpose: R35 bounded pre-SERP probe of installer-side utility-interconnection document completeness, cross-document consistency, resubmission rejections and PTO workflow (not solar permitting or solar CRM). Commercial pain evidenced by installers; buyers already pay existing workflows; competitive moat not yet proven.

business_preflight.buyer: US solar installers / EPC permit and interconnection coordinators
business_preflight.problem: Documents rejected as incomplete or inconsistent; utility-specific changes and submission rework
business_preflight.wedge: Source-cited utility-specific preflight + document consistency warnings, no utility credential automation and no generic CRM
business_preflight.monetization_hypothesis: Per-project QA report, paid integrations or installer subscription; published competitor sticker prices are market benchmarks, not verified willingness to pay for this product
risks: PG&E already has portal-side built-in validation
GridProjeX offers similar applicant-side verified-document and checklist workflow
Proprietary source-change tracking/exception data network is not proven
Search volume and unique monetizable intent must be verified by R35 before further investment
business_preflight.spend_guardrail: 6 exact new root seeds; no extension round unless R35 forms a coherent numeric demand cluster; max two exact-SERP candidates and one query per candidate
